इमरान हाशमी का जलवा, अब सीधे फैंस से होगी मुलाकात! 🔥

इमरान हाशमी अपनी आने वाली फिल्म Gunmaaster G9 के प्रमोशन के लिए मुंबई आ रहे हैं।
वे 24 नवंबर को दोपहर 3 बजे बांद्रा के Gaiety Galaxy थिएटर में अपने फैंस से मिलेंगे।
इमरान ने Instagram वीडियो के जरिए खुद इस मुलाकात का ऐलान किया है।
इसी दिन फिल्म की एडवांस बुकिंग भी पूरे देश में शुरू कर दी जाएगी।
फिल्म 27 नवंबर को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होने के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार है।
Aditya Datt द्वारा निर्देशित इस फिल्म में जेनेलिया देशमुख और अपारशक्ति खुराना भी अहम भूमिकाओं में हैं।
दो दशक बाद इमरान और Himesh Reshammiya की जोड़ी फिर से एक साथ वापसी कर रही है।
क्या आप इमरान हाशमी की इस नई एक्शन फिल्म को देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? 🎬🍿🤩

क्या आप 24 नवंबर को गेयटी गैलेक्सी में इमरान से मिलने जा रहे हैं?

The actor announced the interaction through an Instagram video, inviting audiences to meet him at the Bandra single-screen theatre at around 3 PM.
Emraan Hashmi is taking the promotions of his upcoming action entertainer Gunmaaster G9 directly to audiences with an on-ground fan interaction in Mumbai. The actor announced that he will visit Gaiety Galaxy, popularly known as G7, on Tuesday, November 24, at around 3 PM for a meet-and-greet with fans.
On Monday, November 23, Hashmi shared a video message on his official Instagram handle, inviting fans and moviegoers to gather at the iconic Bandra theatre for an in-person interaction. The visit comes just days before the film’s scheduled theatrical release on November 27 and gives audiences an opportunity to meet the actor during its promotional campaign.
In the same video, Hashmi also confirmed that advance bookings for Gunmaaster G9 will open nationwide on November 24. The announcement has prompted enthusiastic responses from fans on social media, with several expressing their plans to turn up at Gaiety Galaxy and book tickets for the film’s opening day.
The choice of venue adds a single-screen theatre dimension to the film’s promotions, with Gaiety Galaxy having a long-standing association with Mumbai’s moviegoing culture. Hashmi’s visit also brings the campaign closer to audiences who have followed his work across theatrical releases over the years.
A post shared by Soham Rockstar Entertainment (@sohamrockstrent)
Directed by Aditya Datt, Gunmaaster G9 reunites Hashmi with the filmmaker and music composer Himesh Reshammiya, the team behind the 2005 film Aashiq Banaya Aapne . The upcoming action entertainer marks their collaboration more than two decades after that musical release, this time in a different genre.
The film also stars Genelia Deshmukh and Aparshakti Khurana in pivotal roles. Produced by Deepak Mukut and Hunar Mukut under the banner of Soham Rockstar Entertainment, it features music composed by Reshammiya and is positioned as an action-driven theatrical entertainer.
Gunmaaster G9 is scheduled to arrive in cinemas nationwide on Friday, November 27, 2026.
